items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Well, Miele, I knew Miele all my life. Miele related to me. But I never played with him

ctx.x: Oh, you didn't tell me much about Miele Barnes.

Well, Miele, I knew Miele all my life. Miele related to me. But I never played with him or, you know, and the only time I really got to really him, Miele, been a nice fellow all the days, but the only time I got to him was, you know, when he's the preservation, all opened up and all that, you know. But like Miele, Paul Barnes, all that's my relatives, Saif Frazier, Lawrence Marrero, all that's family. Very close too. Sisters and brothers, children, you know.

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And Dave Williams is in my side.

ctx.x: What did he play? Something. Was he Sugar? He played with Black Patty. Sure, you know. What was his last name? No, I'll tell you.

Was he in any relation to Sugar Johnny? No. What branch of the family did he come in? On the daddy's side. On the daddy's side. Well, you've got a lot of cousins in music. Now what about Marrero? That's all first cousins. They're first cousins? Yeah. Yeah. Well, Marrero's on my mother's side. I see. Now you take the Frazier's on my mother's side. And Dave Williams is in my side.
